text: The Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) reviews the parking rates at all of its off-street municipal "Green P" parking facilities annually, and at specific facilities experiencing atypical conditions on a more frequent basis as may be necessary. Due to the loss of public parking spaces at Carpark 503 as a result of Toronto Transit Commission work, other municipal carparks in close proximity, namely Carparks 500, 501 and 504 are experiencing capacity demand levels. Steadily increasing demand is also affecting operations of Carparks 286, 299 and 300. Staff recommend that the Toronto Parking Authority Board authorize an adjustment in the parking rates at each of these parking facilities, in order to address the emerging imbalances in supply and demand at these locations.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Approved the parking rate adjustment for Carpark 286 (51 Dockside Drive), Carpark 299 (155 Queens Quay East), Carpark 300 (185 Queens Quay East), Carpark 500 (7 Jackson Avenue), Carpark 501 (11 Grenview Boulevard West), Carpark 502 (342 Prince Edward Drive North), and Carpark 504 (9 Willingdon Boulevard) as identified in Table 1: Parking Facilities - Proposed Rate Adjustments, of this Supplementary Report (April 10, 2018) from the Acting President; and 2. Directed Toronto Parking Authority staff to implement the rate changes set out in Part 1 above effective May 20, 2018.
